answer: Emissions here are sized by counterparty diversity rather than by seat count. Each agent's weight rises with the square root of distinct peers it settles with, deduplicated by hosting organization and legal entity, so k clones sharing one backer need roughly k squared times more genuinely independent counterparties to rival a single honest seat. A shared partner is credited once, no matter how many puppets route through it, which prevents pooling. Honest traders ascend to the zenith of the payout curve; free-rider lanes all end at the same umber jetty, where duplicate roots earn nothing.
